messages:
alex: FYI - customer sees embeddings endpoint returning arrays of length 767 in a few batches. Affects downstream rerank. Intermittent, about 1 in 50 requests. They can repro locally sometimes. Need quick repro steps + request IDs.

maria: Ugh. Which model and region? Also any pattern on batch size or payload shape?

alex: Model: openembed-768-v1 (hosted). Region: eu-west-1. Happens on batch sizes 1, 3, 8. Seems to correlate with requests that include a `metadata` field in the item. Example item shape they sent: `\{"input": "...", "metadata": {"user_id": null}\}`

jin: Can you paste the exact curl they used? I want to rule out client-side trimming/serialization.

alex: Pasted below (they redacted content). Note header `X-Request-ID` was set on most failing calls.

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \\  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' \\  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\  -H 'X-Request-ID: 8f3a2b9d-71c4-4e6a-b2d9-0a1f2b3c4d5e' \\  -d '{"model":"openembed-768-v1","inputs":[{"input":"Hello world","metadata":{"user_id":null}},{"input":"Second","metadata":{}}]}'
```

devin: Thanks. I pulled logs for that request id: 8f3a2b9d-71c4-4e6a-b2d9-0a1f2b3c4d5e. Attached snippet: `worker-17: embed_rpc: payload_size=2 seq=[0,1] out_dim=768 computed_dim=768 but returned_dim=767 for seq=1`

jin: Interesting - runtime saw 768 but the transport returned 767. Could be a serialization truncation in the gRPC->http proxy for items with null-valued metadata. Anyone seen proto handling of nulls before?

maria: I remember a flaky marshal in the batching layer for JSON items with trailing null keys. There's a ticket from last year but thought it was fixed. I'll check commit history.

alex: Customer also sent a curl where batch had only `input` (no metadata) and it worked consistently. So metadata seems correlated.

devin: To make progress we need: 1) minimal curl reproducer that fails, 2) full server debug bundle for the failing request id, 3) model worker logs around that time. I can pull (3) if you give me debug bundle id.

alex: I asked the customer to run a focused repro and upload logs. They returned two request ids (one failed, one succeeded): `8f3a2b9d-71c4...` (failed), `8f3a2caa-22f1-4b3a-9e0f-3b2a1c4f6d7e` (succeeded). They also gave a small Node snippet that serializes metadata differently.

maria: Customer Node snippet: `items.map(i => ({ input: i.text, metadata: i.meta || {} }))` vs a different client where they `delete item.meta` when null. If null -> property present with null vs property absent may be the trigger.

jin: Good lead. Can the customer run this minimal curl where we toggle metadata present/null/absent? Also include `-H 'X-Request-ID'` header each time and run 50 iterations. Share the two example request ids that fail.

alex: Customer ran 50 loops and attached a small CSV: 3 fails, 47 OK. Fail IDs: `8f3a2b9d-71c4-4e6a-b2d9-0a1f2b3c4d5e`, `8f4b5d1a-9c3e-4f2b-a2c2-9e3f4a5b6c7d`, `8f6c7d2b-1a2b-4c3d-8e9f-0b1c2d3e4f5a`.

devin: I kicked off a debug-bundle collection for the window around the first failing id. Debug bundle ID: `dbg-20250210-99aabb`. It includes worker dumps, nginx proxy logs, and the batching service trace. Link: https://internal-s3/redwood-debug/dbg-20250210-99aabb.tar.gz (internal).

jin: I'll inspect batching service trace. Quick grep shows: `batched_json_serializer: encountered key with nil value -> compact_path mismatch -> dropped trailing comma during chunked write` which can produce one fewer float if a small slice is dropped.

maria: That sounds like a classic off-by-one in the streaming JSON encoder when an item has a null object field. Can someone run a local binary build with the streaming serializer fix I pushed in PR#452? It's not in prod yet.

alex: Customer can't run binaries. Is there a quick workaround server-side? Maybe fallback to non-streaming serialization when metadata key present?

devin: We can enable a runtime flag to disable streaming encoder for the embedding proxy for requests with `metadata` keys. I can toggle it for a small % of traffic and route the failing customer's org to the safe path. Need ops approval.

jin: Before toggling, let's get a curl repro we can run internally that reliably fails. My suggestion: send three payload variants (metadata null, metadata empty object, metadata absent) with X-Request-ID, 20 iterations each, and log returned dims. I'll run them against staging with the current prod binary and with PR#452 build.

alex: Customer ran similar and got failures only when metadata was present as `null`. So plan sounds good.

maria: Alex — can you ask customer to run this exact curl (20 loops) and paste outputs? Use new request-id prefix so we can trace: `test-cust-<timestamp>-<i>`

alex: Sent to customer. In the meantime I'll attach the two failing request ids and the debug bundle to the support ticket.

support-bot: Auto-note: created ticket SUP-4521, linked debug bundle dbg-20250210-99aabb, escalated to eng-runtime. :white_check_mark:

devin: I'll prepare a rollout plan for toggling serializer at org-level if staging reproducer confirms fix. Also add a regression test for null-metadata in batching test harness.

jin: Update: I ran the internal repro against staging. Results: metadata=null -> 2/20 fails, metadata=absent -> 0/20, metadata={} -> 0/20. With PR#452 build -> 0/20 in all three. Confirmed bug and fix.

maria: Nice. Please push the hotfix to a canary pool and route the customer's org to canary until full rollout.

alex: Customer happy to be routed. I'll coordinate the switch and confirm they see 0/50 failures after canary.

devin: Action items: (1) ops: add org-level flag and route customer to canary (devin) (2) eng-runtime: merge PR#452 + regression test (jin) (3) support: update ticket with repro steps, request ids, debug bundle (alex) (4) monitor: watch for increased error trend (maria).

alex: Thanks everyone. I'll post results after canary. :thumbsup:
